newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Ayer Molek in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Ayer Molek in acquisition talks.

text.p: Ayer Molek Rubber Co Bhd said it is holding talks about a corporate restructuring which will involve buying assets.

In a statement sent late on Tuesday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the producer of rubber and oil palm said it was discussing "the terms of a corporate restructuring which will involve the acquisition of substantial assets".
Ayer Molek said that since the talks were still in progress, it could not reveal material information until the discussions were completed.
It asked the exchange to continue suspension of its shares in the meantime.
Ayer Molek stock closed at 119 ringgit on June 5.
